passages.quote:
This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Crew Agreements, Lists of Crew and Discharge of Seamen) Regulations 1991 (SI 1991/2144) (the “Crew Agreement Regulations”) and replaces MGN 474 (M).

Amendment 1 updates references and refines the guidance to current requirements.

All annexes noted within this notice are attached separately and are available to download.

Notice to

shipowners, ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters, officers and seafarers on ships and other sea-going vessels which are not subject to the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006 (MLC)
